sn30.17-46:1.6: “Mendicant, it’s when someone does both kinds of deeds by body, speech, and mind.
sn30.17-46:1.8: ‘The spontaneously-born phoenixes are long-lived, beautiful, and very happy.’
sn30.17-46:1.10: ‘If only, when my body breaks up, after death, I would be reborn in the company of the spontaneously-born phoenixes!’
sn30.17-46:1.14: When their body breaks up, after death, they’re reborn in the company of the spontaneously-born phoenixes.
sn30.17-46:1.15: This is the cause, this is the reason why someone, when their body breaks up, after death, is reborn in the company of the spontaneously-born phoenixes.”
